Building your dataset for the first time?

On your computer, keep the HTML and builder together, then run launch.bat. Or use:

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python build_data.py

Reopen the HTML after a successful build, or transfer data.json to your phone and load it here. No geographic data is invented if the download fails.

Activity log

    Data provenance and snap audit

    Distances exclude the connection from each real feature to its nearest simplified junction. Snaps may cross physical barriers; they are not verified access roads.

    Load a generated dataset first.
    FeatureTypeSnap distanceOSM source
    BUILT TO MAKE ACCESS VISIBLE

    Shubham Parmar
    RescueMesh

    The supplied builder retrieves OSM roads, named hospitals and named localities. It preserves simplified road lengths in metres and each source feature’s coordinates and OSM link. The HTML supports the resulting graph without the old 12-node assumptions.

    Load your generated OSM dataset and inspect its feature sources and snap distances in the data audit.

    Know the model

    • Only motorway, trunk, primary, secondary and tertiary roads. No residential roads, service roads or *_link ramps.
    • Undirected abstraction; one-way and turn restrictions are ignored.
    • Hospital tags do not verify emergency services, capacity or operating status.
    • Locality centres and junction snaps are approximations; weights are illustrative.
    • Study boundaries can remove routes outside the extract.
    • No live flood, traffic or elevation model. No real-world emergency accuracy claim.

    Leaflet mapping, budgeted multi-road search and sourced hotspot scenarios are future upgrades. Single-road ranking is not a multi-road optimum.
